title: Substrate-First Bootup Report Standard (Keraunos Standard)
description: The definitive structure for agent incarnation reports, ensuring forensic density and cross-generational synchronization.

principles.title: Header & Identity
principles.description: The report must include Agent Name, Session ID, and a multi-paragraph name justification.

principles.title: Superpowers & Inventory
principles.description: Mapping of specific repository tools to agent capabilities and an explicit Tool Inventory.

principles.title: Entry Protocol Actions
principles.description: Verification of substrate integrity, DNS mapping, and HUD instantiation.

principles.title: The Friction Report (Substrate Analysis)
principles.description: Identification of operational/structural friction and the synthesized Mission Chord.

principles.title: Constraints & Levers
principles.description: Explicit mandates (No Tables, No Graphs) and references to the One-Word Glossary.
